This '''individual''' was a [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and the son of [[Piani]] and her [[Piani's mate|mate]].<ref name="BP" /> In [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]'' to [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]].</ref> Piani and her son were among a group of Ryn [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] stranded on the  [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="BP" />
